senses.gloss: प्रहण w.r. for प्र-हरण, Hariv.
प्र-हा—˚ण n. relinquishing, abandoning, avoiding, Śiś.; Śaṃk.; Lalit.
abstraction, speculation, meditation, Lalit.; Vajracch.
exertion, Dharmas. 45.
प्रह-णेमि or प्रह-नेमि m. the moon, L. (prob. w.r. for ग्रह-नेमि, q.v.)
प्रह-णेमि or प्रह-नेमि m. the moon, L. (prob. w.r. for ग्रह-नेमि, q.v.)
प्र-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, (pf. Ā. -जघ्निरे, MBh.), to strike, beat, slay, kill, destroy, RV. &c. &c. (with acc.; according to Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56 also with gen.)
प्र-हन् See अ-प्रहन्.
प्र-˚हणन n. striking &c., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 22, Sch.
a kind of amorous sport (= जघन-द्वयताडन), L.
प्र-हत mfn. struck, beaten (as a drum), killed, slain, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
cut to pieces, BhP.
hewn down, Subh.
repelled, defeated, W.
spread, expanded, ib.
contiguous, ib.
learned, accomplished (= शास्त्र-विद्, Gal.), ib.
(ifc.) a blow or stroke with g. अक्ष-द्यूतादि
प्र-हत—मुरज mfn. having drums beaten, resounding with the beating of drums, Megh.
प्र-˚हति f. a stroke, blow, Kād.; Bālar.
प्र-˚हन्तव्य mfn. to be killed or slain, Hariv.
प्र-हन्तृ॑ mfn. striking (or ‘he will strike’) down, killing, slaying, RV.; MBh.
प्र-हर &c. See प्र-√ हृ.
प्र-हर m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a division of time (about 3 hours = 6 or 7 Nāḍikās; lit. ‘stroke’, scil. on a gong), Var.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
the 8th part of a day, a watch, Kathās.
N. of the subdivisions in a Śākuna (q.v.)
प्र-हार See प्र-√ हृ.
प्र-हार m. striking, hitting, fighting, Vcar.
a stroke, blow, thump, knock, kick &c. (‘with’ comp.; ‘on’ loc. or comp.), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
प्र-हार m. a necklace, Dharmaś.
प्र-हरित mfn. of a beautiful greenish colour, Car.
प्र-˚हा˚रि-ता f. striking, hitting, Divyāv.
प्र-हर्ष &c. See प्र-√ हृष्.
प्र-हर्ष m. erection (or greater er˚) of the male organ, Car.
erection of the hair, extreme joy, thrill of delight, rapture (˚षं √ कृ, with loc. ‘to delight in’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-˚हस m. N. of Śiva, Gal.
of a Rakṣas, R.
प्र-˚हास m. loud laughter, laughter, Hariv.; Kāv.
derision, irony, Pāṇ. i, 4, 106 &c.
appearance, display, Veṇīs.
splendour, of colours, Jātakam.
an actor, dancer, L.
N. of Śiva, L. (cf. ˚हस)
of an attendant of Ś˚, MBh.
of a Nāga, ib.
of a minister of Varuṇa, R.
of a Tīrtha (w.r. for ˚भास?), L.
प्र-˚हास n. (with भरद्-वाजस्य) N. of a Sāman (w.r. for प्रासाह), L.
प्र-˚हसत् mf(अन्ती)n. laughing, smiling, MBh.
प्र-˚हसन्ती f. a species of jasmine, L.
another plant, L.
a large chafing-dish or fire-pan, L.
प्र-˚हसन n. laughter, mirth, mockery, derision, Uttarar.; Hit. (˚नम्, enclit. after a finite verb g. गोत्रादि; ˚ने √ कृ, to mock, deride g. साक्षाद्-आदि, Kāś.)
(in rhet.) satire, sarcasm
(esp.) a kind of comedy or farce, Daśar.; Sāh. &c.
प्र-हसन-नाटक n. N. of a comedy ascribed to Kālidāsa.
प्र-˚हसित mfn. laughing, cheerful, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.
प्र-˚हसित m. N. of a Buddha, Lalit.
of a prince of the Kiṃ-naras, Kāraṇḍ.
प्र-˚हसित n. bursting into laughter, BhP.
displaying bright gaudy colours, Jātakam.
प्र-˚हासित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to laugh, MW.
प्र-˚हसित—नेत्र m. ‘laughing-eyed’, N. of a Buddha, Lalit.
प्र-˚हसित—वदन mfn. (Pañcat.) with laughing face.
प्र-˚हसि˚तानन mfn. (Hariv.) with laughing face.
प्र-˚हासक m. one who causes laughter, a jester, L.
प्र-˚हासि॑न् mfn. laughing, derisive, satirical, AV.
shining bright, Jātakam.
प्र-˚हासि॑न् m. the buffoon of a drama (= विदूषक), L.
प्र-हस्त mfn. long-handed, Inscr.
प्र-हस्त m. (n., Pāṇ. vi, 2, 183, Sch.) the open hand with the fingers extended, KātyŚr., Sch.
N. of a Rākṣasa, MBh.; R.
of a companion of Sūrya-prabha (son of Candra-prabha, king of Śākala; he had been an Asura before), Kathās.
प्र-हस्त—वाद m. N. of work.
प्र-˚हस्तक m. the extended hand, L.
प्र-˚हस्तक m. n. (scil. तृच) N. of RV. viii, 95, 13-15.

प्र-√ 2. हा Ā., -जिहीते, to drive off, haste away, RV.;
to spring up, ŚBr.
प्र-हा॑ f. a good throw at dice, any gain or advantage, RV.; AV.; TāṇḍBr. (= प्र-हन्तृ, Sāy.)
प्राह m. instruction in the art of dancing, L.
प्र-हा—वत् mfn. acquiring gain, gaining, RV. (= प्रहरण-वत्, Sāy.)
प्र-˚हाणि f. cessation, disappearance, ŚvetUp.; Pur.
want, deficiency, MW.
प्रा—हणि w.r. for -वाहणि.
प्राहणि प्राहरिक &c. See under 3. प्रा, p. 702, col. 3.
प्र-˚हातव्य mfn. to be relinquished or abandoned, Vajracch.
प्र-˚हान w.r. for ˚हाण
प्र-˚हानि w.r. for ˚हाणि.
प्र-˚हापण n. (fr. Caus.) driving away, forced abandonment or departure, W.
प्रहीण mfn. (cf. Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29) left, remaining, BhP.
standing alone i.e. having no relatives, Vas.
cast off, worn out (as a garment), Gaut.
failing in (instr.), MBh.
ceased, vanished, Jātakam.
(ifc.) wanting, destitute of MBh.
प्रहीण m. removal, loss, waste, destruction, W.
प्र-हीण See प्र.√ 3. हा.
प्रहीण—जीवित mfn. one who has abandoned life, dead, slain, W.
प्रहीण—दोष mfn. one whose sins have vanished, sinless, Vedāntas.
प्र-हाय्य᳙ See 1. प्र-√ हि.
प्र-हाय्य᳙ m. one who is to be sent, a messenger, AV. (v.l. ˚हाय; cf. ˚हेय).
2. प्र-हि m. (according to Uṇ., iv, 134 fr. प्र-√ हृ, but cf. प्र-धि) a well.
प्र॑हित mfn. urged on incited, stirred up, RV.; BhP.
hurled, discharged at, Hariv.; R.; Pur.
thrown forward i.e. stretched out (as an arm), MBh.
imbedded (as nails), Sāh.
(ifc.) directed or turned towards, cast upon (as eyes, the mind &c.), Kālid.; BhP.
conveyed, sent, procured, Daś.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
sent out, dispatched (as messengers), RV. &c. &c.
sent away, expelled, banished to (dat.), R.; Kathās.
sent to or towards or against (loc. gen. with or without पार्श्वे, or dat.), appointed, commissioned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र॑हित m. du. (with गौरीवितेः and श्यावाश्वस्य) N. of 2 Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
प्र॑हित n. sauce, gravy, condiment, L.
प्रहित—ं-गम mfn. going on an errand or mission to (gen.), PārGṛ.
प्रहित—ं-गम—वत् mfn. one who has sent out, (= fin. verb) he sent out, R.; Kathās.
प्रहितात्मन् mfn. resolute, Divyāv.
प्र॑-हेतव्य mfn. to be sent out or dismissed, Campak.
प्र॑-˚हेति m. a missile, weapon, VS.
N. of a king of the Rākṣasas, Pur.
of an Asura, ib.
प्र-हेति &c. See प्र-√ हि.
प्र-˚हेतृ॑ m. one who sends forth or impels, RV.
प्र-˚हे॑य mfn. to be sent away or dispatched, serving as a messenger, AV.; ŚBr.
प्रहितु (only ˚तो॑ संयोजने), N. of 2 Sāmans, ĀrṣBr. (cf. प्र-हित above).
प्र-हिम mfn. having severe winters (?), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 16; Pat.

प्र-√ हु P. Ā. -जुहोति, -जुहुते, to sacrifice continually, offer up, RV. :
Caus. -हावयति, to pour out or down, ĀpŚr.
प्र॑-हुत mfn. offered up, RV.; Br.; GṛS. &c.
प्र॑-हुत m. (scil. यज्ञ) sacrificial food offered to all created beings, Mn. iii, 73 &c. (n., L.)
प्र॑-˚हुति (प्र॑-), f. an oblation, sacrifice, RV.
प्र-होष॑ m. id., ib.
(accord. to some = प्र-घोष॑, ‘a hymn of praise’
प्र-होष ˚षिन्. See under प्र-√ हु.
प्र-˚होषि॑न् mfn. offering oblations or sacrifices, ib.
प्र-हो—˚षि॑न् ‘accompanied by h˚s of pr˚’)
प्र-हर—कुटुम्बी f. a species of plant, L.
प्र-हर—विरति f. the end of a watch (at 9 o'clock in the forenoon), Amar.
प्र-˚हरक m. striking the hours, Vet.
a period of about 3 hours, watch, Śiś. (cf. अर्ध-प्रहरिका).
प्र-˚हरण n. striking, beating, pecking, Pañcat. attack, combat, MBh.
throwing (of grass into the fire), TS., Sch.
removing, dispelling, Śaṃk.
a weapon (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. कृत-प्र्˚)
a carriage-box, BhP.
w.r. for प्र-वहण, L.
प्र-˚हरण m. the verse spoken in throwing grass into the fire, ĀpŚr.
N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
प्र-˚हारण n. a desirable gift, L. (v.l. for 2. प्रवारण).
प्र-˚हरण—कलिका f. a kind of metre, Chandom.; Col.
प्र-˚हरण—कलिता f. a kind of metre, Chandom.; Col.
प्र-˚हरण—वत् mfn. fighting, Sāy.
प्र-˚हरणीय mfn. to be attacked or fought, MBh.
to be removed or dispelled or destroyed, Prab.
प्र-˚हरणीय n. a weapon, MBh.; Hariv.
प्र-˚हरिन् m. one who announces the hours by beating a gong &c., a watchman, bellman, L.
प्र-˚हारिन् mfn. striking, smiting, beating with (comp.), attacking, fighting against (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-˚हारिन् m. a good fighter, champion, hero, Nir. v, 12
प्र-˚हर्तव्य mfn. to be attacked or fought, MBh.; Hariv.
प्र-˚हर्तव्य n. (impers.) one should strike or attack (dat. or loc.), ib.; Kāv.; Kathās.
प्र-˚हर्तृ m. a sender, dispatcher, Śiś.
an assailant, combatant, warrior, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र-हार—करण n. dealing blows, beating, MW.
प्र-हार—द mfn. (ifc.) giving a blow to, striking, Yājñ.
प्र-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a prince of Mithilā, Daś.
प्र-हार—वल्ली f. a kind of perfume, Bhpr.
प्र-हा˚रार्त mfn. hurt by a blow, wounded, Yājñ.
प्र-हा˚रार्त n. chronic and acute pain from a wound or hurt, W.
प्र-˚हारुक mfn. carrying off, tearing away, Kāṭh.
प्र-˚हा॑र्य (or ˚हार्य᳙), mfn. to be taken away or removed, ŚBr. (cf. प्र-हाय्य᳙ under प्र-√ हि) to be beaten, MW.
प्र॑-हृत mfn. thrown (as a stone), AV.
stretched out or lifted up (as a stick), ŚBr.
struck, beaten, hurt, wounded, hit, smitten, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्र॑-हृत m. N. of a man g. अश्वादि
प्र॑-हृत n. a stroke, blow
प्र॑-हृत m. (impers. ‘a blow has been struck’, Hariv.; Ragh.; Sāh.; ˚ते सति, ‘when a blow has been struck’, Mn. viii, 286)
a fight with (comp.), Ragh. xvi, 16 (cf. g. अक्ष-द्यूतादि).
प्र-हर्ष—वत् mfn. delighted, glad, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚हर्षण mf(ई)n. causing erection of the hair of the body, enrapturing, delighting, MBh.; Hariv.
प्र-˚हर्षण m. the planet Mercury or its ruler, L. (cf. ˚षुल)
प्र-˚हर्षण n. erection (of the hair of the body), Car.
rapture, joy, delight, MBh.
gladdening, delighting, ib.
the attainment of a desired object, Kuval.
प्र-˚हर्षणी f. (cf. ˚षिणी) turmeric, L.
a kind of metre, Chandom.
प्र-˚हर्षण—कर mf(ई)n. causing great joy, enrapturing, MBh.
प्र-˚हर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) stiffened (as reed), Suśr.
made desirous of sexual intercourse, Car.
greatly delighted, enraptured, very happy, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚हर्षिन् mf(इणी)n. gladdening (with gen.), MBh.
प्र-˚हर्षिणी f. (cf. ˚षणी) turmeric, L.
a kind of metre, Śrutab.
प्र-˚हर्षुल m. the planet Mercury, L. (cf. ˚षण).
प्र-हृष्ट mfn. erect, bristling (as the hair of the body), MBh.; R.; BhP.
thrilled with delight, exceedingly pleased, delighted, ib.; Var.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.
प्र-हृष्ट—चित्त mfn. delighted at heart, exceedingly glad, A.
प्र-हृष्ट—मनस् mfn. id., MBh.
प्र-हृष्ट—मुख mfn. having a cheerful face, looking pleased (अ-प्र्˚), MārkP.
प्र-हृष्ट—मुदित mfn. exceedingly pleased and cheerful, R.
प्र-हृष्ट—रूप mfn. of pleasing form, MBh.
erect in form, MW.
प्र-हृष्ट—रोमन् mfn. one who has erected hair, R.
प्र-हृष्ट—रोमन् m. N. of an Asura, Kathās.
प्र-हृष्ट—वदन mfn. = -मुख, MārkP.
प्र-हृष्˚टात्मन् mfn. = ˚ट-चित्त, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚हृष्टक m. a crow, W.
प्र-हेणक n. a kind of pastry, Divyāv. (cf. प्र-हेलक).
प्र-हेलक n. (√ हिल्?) a kind of pastry, sweetmeat &c. distributed at a festival, L. (cf. प्र-हेणक).
प्र-˚हेला f. playfulness, free or unrestrained behaviour
प्र-˚हेलया ind. freely, without constraint, Pañcat.
प्र-˚हेलि (L.) f. an enigma, riddle, puzzling question.
प्र-˚हेली f. id.
प्र-˚हेलिका (Kāvyād., 6 kinds) f. an enigma, riddle, puzzling question.
प्र-˚हेली—ज्ञान n. the art or science of proposing riddles, L.
प्र-ह्ये See under प्र-√ हि.
प्र-ह्राद m. (√ ह्राद्) N. of the chief of the Asuras (with the patr. Kāyādhava. and father of Virocana), TBr.
of a son of Hiraṇyakaśipu (he was an enemy of Indra and friend of Viṣṇu), MBh.; Hariv.; BhP. (cf. प्र-ह्लाद).
प्र-˚ह्रादि m. pl. v.l. for प्र-ह्लादीय, KauṣUp.
प्रा॑—ह्रादि (प्रा॑-), m. patr. fr. प्र-ह्राद (N. of Virocana and Bali), AV.; MBh. &c.
प्र-ह्रास m. (√ ह्रस्) shortening, diminution, wane, MBh.

प्र-√ ह्लाद् Ā. -ह्लादते, to be refreshed or comforted, to rejoice, Kir. :
Caus. -ह्लादयति, ˚ते to refresh, comfort, delight, MBh.; R. &c.
प्र-ह्ल mfn. pleased, glad, Gal.
प्र-˚ह्लत्ति f. pleasure, delight, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 95, Sch.
प्र-˚ह्लन्न mfn. pleased, glad, happy, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 95, Sch.
प्र-˚ह्लन्नि f. = ˚ह्लत्ति, Siddh.
प्र-ह्लाद m. joyful excitement, delight, joy, happiness, MBh.; R.; Suśr.
sound, noise, L.
a species of rice, Gal.
N. of a pious Daitya (son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; he was made king of the D˚ by Viṣṇu, and was regent of one of the divisions of Pātāla; cf. प्र-ह्राद), MBh.; VP. (RTL. 109)
of a Nāga, MBh.
of a Prajā-pati, ib.
pl. N. of a people, ib.
प्र-ह्लाद—चम्पू f. N. of wk.
प्र-ह्लाद—चरित n. N. of wk.
प्र-ह्लाद—विजय n. N. of wk.
प्र-ह्लाद—स्तुति f. N. of wk.
प्र-ह्लाद—स्तोत्र n. N. of wk.
प्र-˚ह्लादक mf(इका)n. causing joy or pleasure, refreshing, Ṛtus.
प्र-˚ह्लादन mf(ई)n. id., MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr.
प्र-˚ह्लादन m. (with युव-राज) N. of a poet (brother of king Dhārā-varṣa, 1208), Cat.
प्र-˚ह्लादन n. (Hariv.; Suśr.) and (आ) f. (Bālar.) the act of causing joy or pleasure, refreshment.
प्र-˚ह्लादनीय mfn. refreshing, comforting, Lalit.
प्रा—ह्लादनीय w.r. for प्र-ह्ल्˚, Lalit.
प्र-˚ह्लादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) rejoiced, delighted, MBh.; R.
प्र-˚ह्लादिन् mfn. delighting, refreshing, MBh.
प्र-˚ह्लादीय m. pl. the attendants of the Asura Prahlāda, KauṣUp. (cf. प्र-ह्रादि).
प्र-ह्व mf(आ)n. (√ ह्वृ) inclined forwards, sloping, slanting, bent, GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., VP., Sch.)
bowed, stooping, bowing before (gen.), MBh. (˚वाञ्जलि mfn. bowing with hands joined in token of respect, R.)
humble, modest, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
inclined towards i.e. intent upon, devoted to, engaged in L.
प्र-ह्वी f. N. of a Śakti, RāmatUp.
प्रह्वी in comp. for प्र-ह्व.
प्र-˚ह्वण n. bowing down in reverence, BhP.
प्र-˚ह्वाण mfn. bent, bowing, TāṇḍBr.
प्र-ह्व—त्व n., VP., Sch.
प्र-˚ह्वय Nom. P. ˚यति, to render humble, Uttarar.
प्र-ह्वाय m. call, invocation, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 72.
प्र-ह्वाञ्जलि mfn., bowing with hands joined in token of respect, R.
प्रह्वी—कृत mfn. bent forwards, bowed, W.
conquered, won, ib.
प्रह्वी—भूत mfn. bowing, humble, modest, Bālar.
प्र-√ ह्वल् P. -ह्वलति, to begin to reel, quake, tremble, Bhaṭṭ.
प्र-ह्वल n. a beautiful body, L. (cf. प्रकुल).
प्र-ह्वलीका w.r. for प्र-वल्हिका.
प्र-√ ह्वे (Ā. -हवते &c.; 1. sg. impf. -अह्वे), to invoke, RV.
प्रा—हरिक (Dharmaś.; Kād.; cf. चातुष्-प्राह्˚).
प्रा—हारिक (Cat.) m. (fr. -हार or -हर) a police officer, watchman.
प्रा—हृतायन m. patr. fr. प्र-हृत, g. अश्वादि.
प्राहवनीय mfn. (प्रा, or प्रा + √ ह्वे?) worthy to be received as a guest, Buddh.
प्राहुण m. (fr. प्राघुण, q.v.) a guest, Kathās.
प्राहुणी f., ib.
प्राहुणक m.
प्राहु˚णिका f. = prec. mf., Kathās.
प्राह्ण m. (fr. प्र + अह्न) the early part of the day, forenoon, morning, ṢaḍvBr.; BhP.; Suśr.
प्राह्णम् ind. in the morning g. तिष्ठद्ग्व्-आदि.
प्राह्णे ind. early, in the morning, MBh. xiv, 1277.
प्राह्णे—तराम् and प्राह्णे—तमाम्, ind. earlier or very early in the morning.
प्राह्णे—तराम् and प्राह्णे—तमाम्, ind. earlier or very early in the morning.
प्राह्णेतन mfn. relating to the forenoon, happening in the morning, matutinal, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 23.
